svg.title: Arunoday A K: a transit map of my work
svg.desc: Transit-map diagram of Arunoday A K's projects since 2024. Lines: Data & Optimisation, Applied AI, Machine Learning, Product & Systems, and a private line with 12 unnamed stations. Stations: Protein Interaction ML, Emotion CNN, NeuroGrip, Gesture Mouse, SolarView, P2P Sharing, UniTrade, WiseEnergy, Hydrogen Literature Miner, AcadEase, Epidemic Simulator, SmartRoute-ADMM, Bitcoin Volatility, Hybrid Forecasting, TfL NUMBAT Optimiser.
